incidentsResolved: GameSync standalone production pack used a nonexistent build:extension script; it now invokes the canonical npm run build and is regression-tested.
Android emulator CI compound shell syntax was split by the emulator action; the lane now runs one checked Bash script.
Android Settings could remain on the launcher with noReset; the fixture now forces the app into the foreground.
Appium session creation incorrectly inherited stepMs and could abort during UiAutomator2 startup; server readiness and session creation now use startupMs.
Opera GX vendor startup pages contaminated or stalled browser-matrix lifecycle; workload diagnostics are isolated and startup-page closing is bounded.
Windows browser-matrix execution could hang indefinitely on a leaked branded-browser runtime; each browser now runs in a killable worker process with explicit deadlines.
Browser trace/context teardown could hang; teardown is bounded and force-close fallback is evidence-visible.
Workbench desktop shutdown could deadlock on its own HTTP connection; server shutdown now closes idle/all connections and Electron shutdown is bounded.
Electron runtime handles could survive a completed run; Electron targets now execute inside killable worker processes.
Windows Workbench identity capture could race asynchronous dashboard startup; Ferrum now waits for the first real Electron window before querying main-process identity.

An unauthenticated private GitHub Wiki Git probe can return 404 for an existing wiki; Ferrum now uses available GitHub tokens and authenticated browser-root preflight so false 404s never automatically open or submit the first-page editor.
Process targets could launch interactive CLIs but could not drive stdin; Ferrum now supports bounded write-stdin and close-stdin process steps while preserving normal lifecycle evidence.
Evidence bundles lacked a cryptographic payload inventory; finalized bundles now write SHA-256 manifests and CLI/MCP verification detects tampering without dropping raw evidence.
MV3 popup text assertions could sample asynchronous content too early; assert-text now retries within one bounded deadline and reports the final observed text on failure.

A transient Appium find-all could return zero matches before Android UI convergence; constrained find-all now retries only within the existing step deadline, preserves the required threshold, and records final count plus attempt diagnostics.

STATUS monotonicity originally recognized only verifiedProduct evolution ledgers; checkpoint normalization now recognizes verifiedProduct, improvement, and product records whose trees were proven identical to an exact-head verified proposal.

A merged and fully verified Stack candidate could leave STATUS stale and retain a verification-in-progress marker; promotion now updates the verified toolchain/product identity and tests reject stale candidate markers.

Resolved ENV/VAR credentials and remote Appium/provider values could enter durable evidence; Ferrum now recursively redacts sensitive keys, credential-bearing URLs, bearer tokens and tracked sensitive substitutions at evidence boundaries while preserving real runtime inputs.

Evidence IDs '.' and '..' could collapse evidence paths to the evidence root or its parent; the shared validation boundary now rejects both aliases while preserving the existing accepted ID character set.

Evidence history summary reads were serialized; the verified implementation now uses a bounded 32-worker async pool while preserving the complete finalized run set, malformed/incomplete skip behavior, and chronological ordering.

Chromium accepted extension service-worker termination before Playwright reliably emitted worker-close; Ferrum now proves the exact service-worker target disappeared through CDP before declaring termination complete.
Process assert-log could consume the full remaining timeout after a child had already closed; Ferrum now fails promptly with exit/signal diagnostics after checking final output.

Opaque Node process crashes lacked structured secret-safe runtime context; optional Ferrum-owned Node diagnostic reports now retain useful crash/stack/resource evidence while excluding raw environment/network data.
Process health checks and final WebDriver lookups could overrun their enclosing deadline via a fresh per-request timeout; they now use the remaining bounded budget and report attempts/final state.

Evidence timelines exposed wall-clock timestamps but required agents to derive run-relative timing; events now include monotonic elapsedMs and finalized/compact results expose direct durationMs without hiding raw evidence.

Process targets could health-check a service but could not directly exercise its API; Ferrum now supports bounded HTTP requests with retained full-response evidence, and transport failures wait only briefly for the authoritative child terminal state so real process exits are attributed instead of being flattened into generic fetch errors.
observedNonBlockingWarnings: Opera GX emitted one bounded startup-page-close warning in an earlier Windows evidence bundle because its vendor startup page did not close within 10000ms.
